title: Periodontal re-evaluation after SRP, pockets improved

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: This is your six-week re-eval after the deep cleaning.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Number two distobuccal is down to four. Number three is down to three everywhere.

transcript.speaker: HYGIENIST
transcript.text: Number five distal is still five, bleeding there.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Good improvement. Let's put her on three-month perio maintenance.
